screens.name: Home
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a dominant orb, separate example question, unavailable omen and persistent navigation; supplied runtime evidence reports proportional checks.
findings: Give the unavailable omen a contextual recovery action and verify that the example question remains understandable throughout its entrance.

screens.name: Approach
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows consistent transition and settled compositions, while supplied evidence describes a 650ms automatic advance.
findings: Verify that automatic advancement neither steals focus nor announces an unnecessarily transient screen.

screens.name: Ask — normal text
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a labeled question field, voice alternative and distinct submit button, with modest positional change between entry and settlement.
findings: Verify keyboard-safe submission and preserve the question and available balance through validation failures.

screens.name: Ask — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the enlarged question and disclosure occupying the viewport with submission below the captured area, despite reported zero horizontal overflow.
findings: Reduce decorative space at enlarged text sizes and demonstrate that submission remains reachable with the keyboard open.

screens.name: Follow-up 1
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows a stable question hierarchy, three-step indicator and four consistent answer rows across transition and settled images.
findings: Clarify whether choosing an answer advances immediately and demonstrate a perceptible selected state before advancing.

screens.name: Follow-up 2
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show readable obstacle choices and a matching second-step indicator without a conspicuous composition change.
findings: Verify that Back preserves the selected obstacle and that assistive technology announces the new question.

screens.name: Follow-up 3
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the final question, short support choices and a third-step indicator in consistent transition and settled layouts.
findings: Make the final selection’s move into prediction generation explicit and verify that it cannot submit twice.

screens.name: Custom answer — normal text
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows a checked custom-answer row, labeled empty field and disabled Continue, but the orb has an abrupt horizontal cutoff in both captures.
findings: Remove the orb’s hard clipping boundary while preserving room for the custom field and Continue button.

screens.name: Custom answer — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the selected custom option and Continue at enlarged text, while the question is outside the captured viewport and a small graphic fragment remains above the choices.
findings: Keep enough question context visible during custom entry and remove the stray decorative fragment at this scroll position.

screens.name: Listening — microphone unavailable
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a microphone failure notice with permission guidance and a typing alternative, while hardware speech remains explicitly unverified.
findings: Change the failed-state listening action to a clear retry label and verify accessible announcement of the persistent error.

screens.name: Planning — loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows readable loading copy, an up-to-a-minute expectation, credit reassurance and Cancel in similar entry and settled compositions.
findings: Verify an announced loading status, keyboard-accessible cancellation and a bounded timeout recovery.

screens.name: Research — loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show distinct research-stage copy and cancellation, with brighter mist moving behind the upper controls.
findings: Keep the moving atmosphere away from controls and verify that stage changes are announced without repetitive loading chatter.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows an explicit failed-reading state, unchanged-credit reassurance, Try again and Edit question using labeled fixture content.
findings: Verify that retry retains the question and returns focus to an announced result or error.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show contextual retry, answer review and question editing, with atmospheric variation between entry and settlement.
findings: Preserve all supplied answers across each recovery route and maintain stable contrast behind the close control.

screens.name: Reveal
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show a readable settled forecast, subdued mid-entry text, uncertainty labeling and a prominent share action above several secondary actions.
findings: Reduce the competing follow-up actions and keep the forecast legible throughout its entrance.

screens.name: Reveal — expanded explanation
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 shows an explicit expanded state and readable explanation below the forecast, with the synthetic long-content fixture extending beyond the viewport.
findings: Structure long explanations into scannable sections and verify focus and scroll preservation when expanding or collapsing.

screens.name: Check-in
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 places three outcome choices adjacent to the forecast, and supplied runtime evidence reports outcome persistence without showing its selected confirmation here.
findings: Show an unmistakable saved outcome state and let users revise it without competing with the share action.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — planning
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows a clear redirect, support link, alternative question route and reassurance that no reading or memory was used.
findings: Give the support route stronger visual priority than restarting the entertainment flow.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect — prediction
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show the same recovery structure against brighter mist, while supplied evidence reports a real sensitive redirect.
findings: Prioritize support and verify its destination, accessible label and return behavior on a physical device.

screens.name: History — empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a coherent empty state, device-local storage explanation and direct Ask the Ball action with consistent transition framing.
findings: Verify that the understated empty-state action has a full accessible touch target.

screens.name: History — populated
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows a dated question and forecast row with Waiting status, and supplied runtime evidence reports persistence.
findings: Make row interactivity and the meaning of Waiting explicit, including when a check-in becomes due.

screens.name: History — 20-item stress
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows consistently separated synthetic history entries with a partially visible lower row immediately above the fixed tab bar.
findings: Demonstrate that the final entry and its actions scroll fully clear of the raised Ask control and tab bar.

screens.name: Sky
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows labeled sample stars, a gold selected category, a corresponding question and a strong Ask this too action.
findings: Add a non-color selected marker and explain what the My school switch changes in this sample state.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows privacy guidance, an offline notice and reconnect action beneath an apparently available Create my circle button.
findings: Place offline status beside circle creation and make the availability of creation and sharing controls explicit.

screens.name: Plans — normal text
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show explicit billing units, selected yearly pricing and simulation labels, but the settled capture cuts off the orb beneath the fixed header.
findings: Remove the hard header clipping of the orb and verify that all plan choices and purchase feedback remain reachable.

screens.name: Plans — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows enlarged billing details split into narrow columns and a two-line primary action, with other plan content outside the captured viewport.
findings: Stack pricing and billing details vertically at enlarged text sizes to prevent fragmented reading.

screens.name: You — empty memory
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows plan status, memory purpose, an empty-memory explanation and grouped settings with a consistent entry composition.
findings: Verify and capture the populated memory, edit and Undo states reported by the runtime drive.

screens.name: Settings controls — normal text
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows labeled sound, motion and text switches, with differing off-track colors and no visible textual on/off values.
findings: Standardize switch-state styling and verify that each setting exposes its current value to assistive technology.

screens.name: Settings controls — 200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows enlarged labels and a teal enabled text switch, while the fixed tab labels remain small and lower content approaches the bar.
findings: Verify enlarged navigation labels and full scroll clearance for the final settings action.

screens.name: Share
screens.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show a framed preview and distinct export routes, while supplied evidence confirms PNG export but leaves native sharing and the social backend unverified.
findings: Make availability and outcomes explicit for video and private-link routes, including the unavailable social backend.

screens.name: Story card
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a restrained card, uncertainty disclaimer and prominent export action, with Back to sharing near or beyond the lower viewport edge.
findings: Verify that export success is announced and that Back to sharing remains fully reachable at enlarged text sizes.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The orb establishes a consistent focal point across the sheets but has abrupt clipping in custom-answer and settled Plans captures.
findings: Prevent hard clipping and verify appropriate button semantics on Home versus decorative treatment elsewhere.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Main screens show five labeled destinations, an underlined active tab and raised Ask orb, with very small labels even in the enlarged settings capture.
findings: Support enlarged labels and verify target bounds, active-tab announcements and content clearance around the raised orb.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: The header consistently pairs identity or screen title with a small daily balance, while supplied runtime evidence reports available-balance assertions.
findings: Distinguish daily allowance from purchased credits and announce balance changes after completion or purchase.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream rounded buttons stand out consistently, and the empty custom-answer screen shows a visibly disabled Continue state.
findings: Verify pressed, focused, busy and disabled semantics, including a clear reason when the primary action is unavailable.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold or cream text actions appear consistently but range from separated recovery rows to crowded reveal links and small close glyphs.
findings: Standardize actionable spacing and verify 44pt targets and visible focus for text links, close and back controls.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Question screens use evenly separated underlined rows, with a checkmark and gold text explicitly marking the custom selection.
findings: Apply equally clear selected feedback to standard answers and verify group labels and automatic-advance announcements.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: The normal Ask field has a persistent label and readable content inside a prominent gold rectangle.
findings: Distinguish resting, focused and invalid borders and verify an accessible label independent of placeholder text.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: The 200% Ask field expands substantially, while the enlarged custom field is visible without its question context.
findings: Adapt surrounding decoration and scrolling so enlarged input retains context and a reachable keyboard-safe submit action.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Settings and social screens show compact switches with gray, brown and teal tracks across their represented states.
findings: Use consistent state colors and verify full-row touch targets, accessible names and spoken on/off values.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Home shows a free-omen label and an unavailable message asking the user to return tomorrow.
findings: Explain whether the omen is delayed or unavailable for the day and provide the appropriate refresh or return cue.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 13 pairs scattered labeled stars with a selected question, using gold to distinguish Love from the other categories.
findings: Add a non-color selected indicator and verify generous targets and a predictable reading order for the constellation.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: The offline Circles screen combines privacy explanations, creation, a sharing switch and reconnection in one borderless flow.
findings: Group the offline explanation with affected controls and explicitly distinguish available actions from unavailable ones.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Populated and stress captures use a narrow date column, question, larger forecast and small Waiting status separated by fine rules.
findings: Expose each row as a clearly named action and replace ambiguous Waiting status with meaningful check-in timing.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Yearly selection includes a checkmark, billing total and monthly equivalent, but enlarged two-column layouts fragment the text.
findings: Stack enlarged pricing details and verify single-selection semantics and an announced updated purchase summary.

components.name: Share preview
components.evidence: Share and Story screens show a coherent portrait card, with very small disclaimer and brand text in the reduced preview.
findings: Provide an accessible text equivalent and verify disclaimer readability in the actual exported asset.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Error and voice states name the problem and offer contextual alternatives, and supplied runtime evidence reports recovery assertions.
findings: Verify live announcements, focus placement and persistence for each recovery notice rather than relying on visual presence alone.

components.name: Typography
components.evidence: Serif forecasts, script ritual headings and sans-serif controls create consistent roles, while metadata and navigation remain comparatively small.
findings: Increase small supporting text and verify contrast and enlargement across every text role.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: The dark gold atmosphere matches the material direction, but bright mist crosses controls and reading regions while the current motion trace remains unfinished.
findings: Limit atmosphere luminance behind text and verify stable contrast, reduced motion and frame performance across complete transitions.

limitations: All functional scores are provisional: this evaluation uses attached screenshots and supplied runtime claims without independently replaying interactions or inspecting measurement files.
Every labeled settled capture and its corresponding transition is covered; captures with overlapping content are retained as separate key states where their purpose or text size differs.
No item reaches the authorized A >=9 and F >=9 threshold; dimension averages must use only applicable dimensions, and no 9/10 certification is supported.
No blocked task, data loss or inaccessible primary control is conclusively demonstrated; offscreen content and clipped decoration warrant checks but do not alone establish a hard-gate failure.
Zero horizontal overflow does not establish vertical reachability, keyboard clearance, comfortable reading, target size or assistive-technology usability.
Mid-entry samples show composition and opacity differences but cannot establish animation smoothness, timing, continuous contrast or compliance with motion preferences.
Reported real-drive success supports provisional functionality; fixture predictions and repeated stress content provide no evidence of predictive accuracy or model quality.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware, haptics, real payments, social backend and OS sharing remain unverified.
Populated memory, saved outcome selection, export completion, reminder preview and purchase confirmation are reported in runtime evidence but lack attached screenshots for visual grading.
topFixes: Remove hard orb clipping in custom-answer and Plans states and the decorative fragment in enlarged custom entry.
Adapt 200% layouts by reducing decorative space, stacking pricing and demonstrating keyboard-safe access to primary actions.
Make offline Circles availability explicit beside creation and sharing controls.
Strengthen selected and saved states for stars, answers and outcomes using non-color cues and accessible announcements.
Reduce competing reveal actions and prioritize support on sensitive redirects.
Complete motion, contrast, target-size and physical assistive-technology checks before claiming premium or threshold acceptance.
